question: Does exact repetition of the first RC1.2 alphabetical word across consecutive P lines within a single IVTFF block deviate from a within-block first-word permutation null?

parser.name: RC1.2
parser.block_rule: IVTFF <%>...<$> within a single page; page boundary resets; enumerate all incomplete and divergent blocks
parser.first_word_rule: First alphabetical [A-Za-z]+ token after RC1.2 cleanup; strip comments, join brace content and exclude whole square-bracket alternatives

scope.page_policy: No protected folios used in a scientific evaluation; canonical full-corpus totals apply only to structural provenance, never to training population
scope.currier: Currier A/B from page $L, other and mixed blocks excluded and counted
scope.unit: P lines with nonempty RC1.2 first token within one IVTFF block
scope.pair_denominator: One ordered pair of immediately consecutive physical P lines with no missing/intervening locus, within the same page and block; no cross-boundary adjacency
scope.endpoint_formula: O=sum(1[first_word_i==first_word_next]) over eligible pairs; E=mean of O from 10000 within-block permutations; O/E; E==0 => NOT VERIFIABLE
scope.strata: Pooled common allowed folios primary; A/B descriptive only

null_model.method: Permute first words across eligible P lines independently in each block; preserve line positions, inventory, row and block geometries; same number of eligible pairs
null_model.p_value: One-sided depletion Monte Carlo (1 + count(null_O <= O)) / 10001
null_model.negative_controls: Synthetic identical-first-word and shuffled-first-word block fixtures; verify deterministic replay and boundary exclusion

uncertainty.cluster_unit: Physical folio f<digits>, merge recto/verso and panels; report exceptional nonnumeric units separately
uncertainty.quantile_method: linear interpolation of sorted bootstrap replicates
uncertainty.uncertainty_limit: Does not model correlated hands/quires or post-selection history

decision_thresholds.SUPPORTED: Both mapped comparable ZL3b and IT2a training analyses: O/E <=0.5, permutation p <=0.01 and cluster-bootstrap 95% upper bound O/E <1, with >=20 physical folio clusters each. Exploratory relative to null only.
decision_thresholds.FALSIFIED: Both mapped comparable analyses: cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound O/E >0.5, contradicting prespecified strong-depletion threshold only, not every possible qo mechanism.
decision_thresholds.INCONCLUSIVE: Parser and sample gates passed, but neither SUPPORT nor FALSIFICATION criteria satisfied; includes discordance between otherwise comparable ZL3b and IT2a.
decision_thresholds.NOT VERIFIABLE: Missing input, protocol, proven parser/block and adjacency mapping, permitted training isolation, matched ZL3b/IT2a, nonzero denominators and E, >=20 clusters, frozen prior commit, runner, or deadline prerequisites.

cross_transcription_rule: IT2a is the same manuscript, not an independent replication; restrict both to identically eligible allowed physical folios, validate block and pair mapping before running; valid outcome discordance => INCONCLUSIVE; missing mapping => NOT VERIFIABLE.
multiplicity: One pooled primary endpoint with joint support criterion across both transcriptions. Currier A/B strictly descriptive, not unreported additional inferential tests.
provenance_caveat: Prior Voynich patterns, filters and competing O/E estimates already inspected; this timestamped freeze improves traceability but is not independent confirmation. No Timm–Schinner generator claims under NULL_ONLY.
